scope: The Pyynikki Observation Tower and its connected ground-floor café at Näkötornintie 20, Tampere, as photographed in September 2011. The separate radio mast is excluded.

originalReview.notes: The exact September 2011 ridge view shows the tower lantern, warm reddish granite, dark upper window apertures, the upper cornice and a small rooftop projection. The tall separate radio mast is outside the model.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the sole Commons upload. Juho Paavisto is the named photographer and uploader and applied an explicit own-work public-domain dedication.
